title: Add Moments CTA and new Moments screen with static photo assets

requirements.summary: After acceptance on the final slide, show an additional CTA labeled exactly "Moments💞" without changing existing Yes/No behaviors.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user clicks "Yes! 💕" on the final slide, the acceptance message (containing the phrase "You are forever mine") still appears as it does today.
After the acceptance message appears, a new clickable option labeled exactly "Moments💞" is visible on that same final slide.
The existing "No" behavior remains unchanged (still shows the rejection message and then only shows the "Yes" option afterward).

file_operations.description: Add a new "Moments💞" CTA that renders only when the final slide state is "yes-accepted", placed after the existing acceptance content so current Yes/No behavior and styling remains unchanged. Use the shadcn-ui Button component (already used in this file) to keep CTA styling consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a distinct Moments screen showing both uploaded photos, a lovely English message, romantic decorations, and a clear way back to the main carousel.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Moments💞" navigates to a distinct view (separate from the carousel view) that is clearly a new page/screen.
The Moments page renders both images: IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and 20260106_172708-2.jpg.
A visible, readable English "lovely message" is present on the Moments page (exact wording may be chosen by the implementer).
The Moments page uses romantic decorations (e.g., hearts/accents/soft glow) and does not look like an unstyled raw image list.
The Moments page provides a clear way to return to the main Valentine carousel/final slide (e.g., a "Back" button).

file_operations.description: Implement the Moments screen UI: a romantic decorated layout (hearts/soft gradients/glass-card effect consistent with the existing theme), render both images, and include one lovely English message plus a clear Back control. Use the existing shadcn-ui Button component for the Back control and any CTA styling consistency; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new Moments screen into the app by adding a lightweight view toggle (carousel vs Moments) and a click handler for "Moments💞" to show the Moments screen, plus a Back handler to return to the carousel. Keep the existing carousel content and Yes/No logic unchanged aside from adding this navigation.

requirements.summary: Ensure uploaded photos are shipped as frontend static assets and referenced correctly so they load in production builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Both uploaded images load successfully on the Moments page in a deployed/production build (not only in local dev).
Images are served from the frontend as static files (not via the backend canister).
No broken image icons or 404s occur for IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and 20260106_172708-2.jpg.

file_operations.description: Add the uploaded image as a public static asset so it is served by the frontend in production builds.
Add the uploaded image as a public static asset so it is served by the frontend in production builds.

Reference the images using production-safe public static paths pointing to frontend/public/assets/IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and frontend/public/assets/20260106_172708-2.jpg so they load reliably after deployment.
